why: Third hypothesis, and the one aimed at the frontier rather than at one axis. mana-recovery bought interaction affordability with THREE BODIES, and lost 1.53 damage at T10 for it. This buys the same mana by cutting NON-BODIES instead: Olivia's Wrath is a five-mana sweeper in a deck whose whole plan is a wide token board and it kills your own 1/1s; Pact of the Serpent is X-based draw the model cannot price and the table rarely casts; Timothar is the one body, and it measured neutral on every axis swept. If the mana was the lever and the bodies were the price, this should hold the damage and keep the interaction.
